info.description:
Point-of-sale and revenue-target API for the Waffle Bros shop in Bhopal. The React screens use exactly this API, so a script can do anything the cashier can.

- **Base URL:** `http://localhost:4000` (or the shop computer's address on the Wi-Fi).
- **Money:** rupees, as JSON numbers (`199.0` is Rs 199).
- **Times:** shop-local (Asia/Kolkata by default); timestamps are `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`, dates `YYYY-MM-DD`, months `YYYY-MM`.
- **Errors:** JSON `{"error": "..."}` with status 400 (bad request), 404 (not found), 422 (validation, `field: reason`) or 501 (not built yet).
- **Auth:** reading and billing are open on the shop network. Menu changes, module settings and backups need the admin PIN: `POST /api/admin/login` returns a token to send as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

Practical guide with real examples: `docs/API.md` in the repository.

post.description:
Returns a bearer token for the admin endpoints. The default PIN is 1234 until changed, and
with it the token can only change the PIN. After 5 wrong PINs from one device, sign-in from it
is locked for 30 s, doubling with every further wrong PIN (429 with `Retry-After`); 30 wrong
PINs from anywhere within 10 minutes lock sign-in for everyone for a while.

With `once: true` the token lasts only a few minutes (the counter's PIN prompt asks for one per
action); otherwise it lasts the admin session length (12 hours).

get.description:
One call for the whole Dashboard, computed for the shop-local *now*. Only paid bills count;
all money is rupees rounded to 2 dp. Keys (full field list and formulas in docs/API.md):

- `target`: this month's target summary: `month`, `target`, `revenue`, `orders`,
  `todayRevenue`, `progressPct`, `expectedPct`, `remaining`, `todayTarget`,
  `requiredDailyFromTomorrow`, `avgDaily`, `projected`, `aov`, `netProfit`, break-even figures
  and an `expenses` breakdown.
- `charts`: arrays `hourly` (today vs 28-day average), `daily` (this month, with even-pace line),
  `weekly` (up to 12 weeks, each with `label` like `16-22 Nov` and `current`), `monthly` (up to
  12 months with target, expenses, `label` like `Nov 2026` and `current`), `categorySplit`,
  `paymentSplit` and `weekday` (8-week average per weekday).
- `insights`: plain-English tips, each `{tone: good|warn|info, title, text}`.
- `items`: the same object as `GET /api/items/stats` for `period`.
- `now`: the shop-local time the numbers were worked out for (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS`), so the
  screens show the shop's clock even if a tablet's own clock or time zone is off.

post.description:
Create a paid bill and return it with its `bill_no` (`WB<yymmdd>-<nnn>`, numbered per day).

Prices come from the menu, never from the request. Totals, in rupees:
`subtotal` = sum of price x qty; `discount` = rupees off before GST (rejected with 400 when
discounts are not allowed or exceed the allowed cap); `tax` = (subtotal - discount) x GST rate
/ 100 (0 when GST is off); `total` = subtotal - discount + tax. `created_at` is the shop-local
time now (`YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`). The bill is queued for the next Google Sheet sync.

post.description:
Needs the admin PIN, so a paid bill can't be quietly cancelled at the counter.
Mark a bill `cancelled` and return it. The bill is kept (bills are history) but no longer
counts towards revenue, targets or item stats; the day-end sheet lists it under `cancelled`.
The next Google Sheet sync appends the bill again with status `cancelled` (the earlier row is
left as it was). Cancelling twice is harmless.
